Sub-configuration#

The dedicated sub-configuration options are

class config.opt_config_tol#

OPT_CONFIG_TOL Configuration options for numerical tolerances in analysis and synthesis

Constructor Summary

OPT_CONFIG_tol constructor

Property Summary
GX_max#

upper bound on norm of primal storage matrix (synthesis)

upper bound on norm of storage matrix (analysis)

K_max#

upper bound on norm of controller state space matrices

M#

X#

dia#

tolerance for acceptable solution

input_diss#

tolerance for strict input dissipation

spread#

class config.opt_config_syn#

OPT_CONFIG_SYN Configuration options for synthesis

Constructor Summary
opt_config_syn()#

OPT_CONFIG_SYN constructor

Property Summary

which elements of D can be nonzero?

reduced_order#

use internal model structure to synthesize reduced-order controllers (LTI and periodic-orbit)

Bisection#

bisect_opts is used only when the Analysis or Synthesis problems are solved in Bisect or Alternating mode. bisect_opts is not required if the problem is solved only once, such as at a fixed linear rate \(\rho\).

class config.bisect_opts#

Bases: handle

BISECT_OPTS options used when applying bisection/alternation in the manager class

Constructor Summary
bisect_opts()#

Constructor

Property Summary
backoff#

increase parameter by backoff when switching between analysis and synthesis. Try to ensure feasibility this way.

bisect#

use bisection or not

bisect_rho#

should bisection occur on rho

spec_ind#

which specification should be bisected

tol#

tolerance for upper bound - lower bound in bisection

val_init#

initial value

val_range#

parameter range used in bisection

warm_factor#

if an initial guess is supplied, expand for an initial range
